name: Movenpick Asara Resort & Spa Hua Hin
short_description: A 95-suite oceanfront resort in tropical gardens with a 4.5/5 ALL rating from over 1,300 reviews, about 2.5 hours from Bangkok.
ai_summary: Mövenpick Asara Resort & Spa Hua Hin is an oceanfront resort set in tropical gardens with lagoons, about 2.5 hours from Bangkok. Its own Accor listing shows a 4.5/5 ALL guest rating from roughly 1,368 reviews, and describes 95 suites and villas ranging from 120 to 400 sqm, private pool villas, beachfront dining, a full-service spa, and pet-friendly stays.

core_facts.address: 53 Hua Hin 5 Alley, Tambon Hua Hin, Amphur Hua Hin, 77110 Hua Hin, Thailand
elite_benefits: Complimentary breakfast or lounge access for ALL Diamond members at participating hotels, per ALL - Accor Live Limitless program terms
Room upgrades for Platinum and Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: 4.5/5 ALL guest rating from roughly 1,368 reviews
95 suites and villas from 120 to 400 sqm, some with private pools

cons: Larger low-rise resort layout may feel less intimate than Hua Hin's smaller villa properties

faqs.question: Is Movenpick Asara Resort & Spa Hua Hin pet-friendly?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the resort is described on its official listing as offering pet-friendly stays alongside private pool villas and beachfront dining. It has 95 suites and villas from 120 to 400 sqm, a full-service spa, and a 4.5/5 ALL guest rating from roughly 1,368 reviews, about 2.5 hours' drive from Bangkok.
